annotations.title: Update a review's summary or title

description: Set or replace a review's summary and/or title, and its display settings. The summary is shown at the top of the review, above every screenshot and note. Display settings: is_numbered (number the items), show_toc (a table of contents at the top), allow_comments (whether people with the link can comment) and product_url (the link to the product the review is about; an empty string removes it). Only the fields passed change.

allow_comments.description: Let people with the link comment on items.

claim_token.description: The claim_token from create_review (authorizes the write). For a review the human has SAVED to their account, pass the agent token they generated on the review page (Export & more → Hand to your agent) here instead.

compared_to.description: Optional: when this run repeats an earlier study, the earlier review's slug or URL. Recorded so re-runs can be compared over time.

is_numbered.description: Number the items (1., 2., ...) on the review page and exports.

product_url.description: The product's link shown on the review (http or https). An empty string removes it.

review.description: The review slug or URL from create_review.

show_toc.description: Show a table of contents at the top of the review.

summary.description: The overview shown at the top of the review. Replaces any existing summary.

name: update_review
